# Toolset `suggests`

Search suggestions for areas, companies, skills and keywords.

**11 tools.** Mutations require an explicit `confirm=true` argument; `Auth` marks tools that need an hh.ru token.

| Tool | Operation | Auth | Confirm | Description |
| --- | --- | :---: | :---: | --- |
| `suggest_area_leaves` | `GET /suggests/area_leaves` | – | – | Suggest leaf regions (cities/districts without children) inside area_id by name prefix; used to pick concrete locations. |
| `suggest_areas` | `GET /suggests/areas` | – | – | Suggest hh.ru regions (areas) by name prefix; returns matching areas with ids. area_id narrows the search to children of a given region, include_parent=true adds the parent region to the response. |
| `suggest_companies` | `GET /suggests/companies` | – | – | Suggest registered employers (companies) by name prefix with their ids and urls. |
| `suggest_educational_institutions` | `GET /suggests/educational_institutions` | – | – | Suggest educational institutions by name prefix with their ids. |
| `suggest_fields_of_study` | `GET /suggests/fields_of_study` | – | – | Suggest fields of study (specialties) by name prefix with their ids for resume and vacancy education blocks. |
| `suggest_positions` | `GET /suggests/positions` | – | – | Suggest job positions (titles) by name prefix for resumes; returns positions with professional role ids. |
| `suggest_professional_roles` | `GET /suggests/professional_roles` | – | – | Suggest professional roles by name prefix with their ids for vacancy and resume search. |
| `suggest_resume_search_keyword` | `GET /suggests/resume_search_keyword` | – | – | Suggest full search phrases for resume search by a partial keyword (employer side). |
| `suggest_skill_set` | `GET /suggests/skill_set` | – | – | Suggest key skills by name prefix with their ids; skill ids are accepted by dict_skills. |
| `suggest_vacancy_positions` | `GET /suggests/vacancy_positions` | – | – | Suggest job positions (titles) by name prefix for vacancies; returns positions with professional role ids. |
| `suggest_vacancy_search_keyword` | `GET /suggests/vacancy_search_keyword` | – | – | Suggest full search phrases for vacancy search by a partial keyword (applicant side). |
